en.title: UK Supreme Court Weakens Disability Safeguards, Sparking Global Accessibility Concerns
en.summary: The UK Supreme Court ruled to weaken deprivation of liberty safeguards for severely disabled people, prompting warnings from charities about increased abuse risk. In related news, Sweden pledged to support Ukraine's digital transformation via improved e-service accessibility, Mississippi joined a federal mental health access program, and Air Canada's accessibility initiatives were highlighted in investor coverage.

zh-TW.title: 英國最高法院削弱殘障保障
zh-TW.summary: 英國最高法院裁決削弱對嚴重殘障人士的剝奪自由保障，慈善機構警告此將增加護理院和醫院中的虐待風險。同時，瑞典宣布將透過提升電子服務無障礙與數位素養來支援烏克蘭的數位轉型。密西西比州加入聯邦計畫以擴大永續心理健康服務的可及性，而加拿大航空的無障礙推動與服務犬計畫則在投資者報導中受到關注。
